invariants.rationale: The method requires a non-null WorkloadProfile to operate, suggesting it is never null at exit.
Main loop iterates over profile.getInputPartitionPathStatMap().entrySet(), which requires this map to be non-null.
profile.getOutputPartitionPathStatMap() is accessed in each iteration; it must be non-null to avoid NPEs.
hasOutputWorkLoadStats() likely reflects the presence of output stats, tied to output map size.
A map's size is always non-negative.
